conditionPreamble:
%%[
VAR @age_raw, @age, @age_ascii_accepted
SET @age_raw = AttributeValue("Age")
SET @age = ""
SET @age_ascii_accepted = 0
IF Empty(@age_raw) THEN
SET @age_ascii_accepted = 1
ELSEIF NOT Empty(RegExMatch(@age_raw, "^[\x00-\x7F]+$", 0)) THEN
SET @age = Lowercase(Trim(@age_raw))
SET @age_ascii_accepted = 1
ENDIF
VAR @age_number, @age_numeric
SET @age_number = 0
SET @age_numeric = 0
IF NOT Empty(RegExMatch(@age, "^-?[0-9]{1,9}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$", 0)) THEN
SET @age_number = Add(@age, 0)
SET @age_numeric = 1
ENDIF
VAR @country_raw, @country, @country_ascii_accepted
SET @country_raw = AttributeValue("Country")
SET @country = ""
SET @country_ascii_accepted = 0
IF Empty(@country_raw) THEN
SET @country_ascii_accepted = 1
ELSEIF NOT Empty(RegExMatch(@country_raw, "^[\x00-\x7F]+$", 0)) THEN
SET @country = Lowercase(Trim(@country_raw))
SET @country_ascii_accepted = 1
ENDIF
VAR @tier_raw, @tier, @tier_ascii_accepted
SET @tier_raw = AttributeValue("Tier")
SET @tier = ""
SET @tier_ascii_accepted = 0
IF Empty(@tier_raw) THEN
SET @tier_ascii_accepted = 1
ELSEIF NOT Empty(RegExMatch(@tier_raw, "^[\x00-\x7F]+$", 0)) THEN
SET @tier = Lowercase(Trim(@tier_raw))
SET @tier_ascii_accepted = 1
ENDIF
VAR @vip
SET @vip = 0
IF (@tier_ascii_accepted == 1 AND NOT Empty(@tier) AND (Length(@tier) >= 3 AND IndexOf(Concat("~", Substring(Concat("vip", @tier), Add(Length(@tier), 1), 3)), Concat("~", "vip")) == 1)) THEN
SET @vip = 1
ENDIF
VAR @welcome_offer
SET @welcome_offer = 0
IF ((@country_ascii_accepted == 1 AND NOT Empty(@country) AND (Length(@country) == 2 AND IndexOf(@country, "us") == 1)) AND (@age_numeric == 1 AND @age_number >= 21)) THEN
SET @welcome_offer = 1
ENDIF
]%%
